text: Given the risks to retail investors of investing in complex unconstrained mutual funds and the SEC's own concern about the retailization of private funds, it is unclear why the SEC has not acted to enhance protections for retail purchasers of unconstrained mutual fund shares.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: Given the risks to retail investors of investing in relatively complex UMFs, and the SEC's overall concern about the "retailization" of private funds, it is unclear why the SEC has not taken action to enhance protections for retail investors seeking to purchase shares of a UMF.
